name: Mercenary for Hire!: a Mercenary can fight back a ruleset player who attacked it in a capital
contract: A Mercenary's client sees a same-faction High-Risk or War Mode player as friendly unless that player carries the free-for-all PvP flag, which the server patches in only outside no-PvP areas, and capitals are no-PvP areas.
Inside a capital the ruleset player could therefore attack the Mercenary while the Mercenary could not attack back. Two Orcs pick High-Risk at the Orgrimmar gate and one takes up Mercenary for Hire!.

Before any fight the Mercenary is not sent the other Orc's free-for-all flag. Once that Orc attacks, the Mercenary is sent the Orc with the hostile Mercenary faction 1163 while they are in combat, the server lets the Mercenary attack back and its swings land. The hostile view lasts until the Orc leaves combat altogether: once the first Mercenary's fight has ended while a second Mercenary keeps the Orc in combat, the Orc's attack on that second Mercenary resends its faction to every viewer, and both Mercenaries are sent the hostile faction. When the Orc leaves combat, its own faction is sent again.
